skill.name: zipcode-lookup
skill.description: 日本郵便の公式データで郵便番号と住所を相互検索する。郵便番号、〒、住所から郵便番号、郵便番号から住所、町域の検索に対応。公式CSVをダウンロードしてローカル検索するのでAPIキー・ログイン不要。宛名印刷・配送・ゆうびんID変換は対象外。
skill.summary: Look up Japanese postal codes and town addresses locally using Japan Post's official UTF-8 dataset.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: All 15 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, legitimate downloads, fixed shell commands, and a documentation link. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration. A separate low-severity concern is archive extraction that can overwrite local files without isolating the destination.

remediation.suggestion: Extract into a new dedicated directory, validate archive member paths, and verify the expected CSV before replacing existing data.

content.user_title: Find Japanese Postal Codes and Addresses
content.value_statement: Japanese postal codes and town addresses can be difficult to match accurately. This skill guides local searches using Japan Post's official data without login credentials.
actual_capabilities: Guide downloads of Japan Post's national UTF-8 postal dataset from its official download page.
Search local CSV data by seven-digit postal code.
Find postal codes through partial town-name searches.
Interpret postal code, prefecture, municipality, and town columns.
Return all matching rows when a postal code covers multiple towns.
Explain download failures, user-assisted alternatives, and monthly refresh practices.
limitations: Initial data acquisition requires network access or a user-supplied official archive.
The author observed download failures from datacenter IP addresses; hosted agents may require a local-machine fallback.
Postal address notation may differ from residential or registered addresses.
Label printing, shipping, and Yubin ID conversion are outside this skill's scope.

use_cases.title: Check Postal Address Fields
use_cases.description: Compare a customer's town and postal code against official postal data before updating an address record.

use_cases.title: Review Japanese Address Data
use_cases.description: Find postal codes for town-name entries and identify ambiguous matches during data cleanup.

use_cases.title: Look Up a Town's Postal Code
use_cases.description: Search a Japanese town name locally without creating an account or requesting an API key.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One Postal Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the address for postal code 1000001 using Japan Post's UTF-8 dataset. Include all matches and the dataset month if known.

prompt_templates.title: Search by Town Name
prompt_templates.prompt: Find postal codes for Marunouchi in Chiyoda City, Tokyo. Search the Japanese town name and include every matching town entry.

prompt_templates.title: Review Multiple Matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the local dataset for postal code [seven-digit code]. Return every matching prefecture, municipality, and town, including any catch-all entry.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced interpretation of shared postal codes

prompt_templates.title: Refresh and Verify Local Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Refresh Japan Post's UTF-8 dataset in a dedicated directory and record its source and download date. Compare [town] matches with my existing dataset.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative address result for postal code 1000001.
output: This is an illustrative result, not a live dataset verification.
A live lookup should also report the dataset month when known.

output_examples.input: The download page opens, but the archive repeatedly returns 404. What is the lookup result?
output: The dataset could not be downloaded, so no lookup result is verified.
The author observed similar failures from datacenter IP addresses.
Download the official archive on your own computer and provide it for local searching.
No postal code will be guessed.

best_practices: Use the official UTF-8 dataset and extract archives into a dedicated directory after checking their contents.
Record the dataset month when available and the download date; refresh approximately monthly.
Return every matching row and distinguish postal notation from residential address notation.
anti_patterns: Guessing postal codes or download URLs when official data is unavailable.
Treating the first match as the only result for a shared postal code.
Extracting an unchecked archive over unrelated workspace files.

faq.question: Which country does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Japanese postal codes and town addresses using Japan Post's official KEN_ALL dataset.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. The workflow downloads public postal data and searches the CSV locally.

faq.question: Can I search by address instead of postal code?
faq.answer: Yes. Partial town-name searches can return matching postal codes. Adding a prefecture and municipality helps distinguish similar names.

faq.question: Why might a hosted agent fail to download the archive?
faq.answer: The author observed archive download failures from datacenter IP addresses. Downloading on your own computer is a documented fallback.

faq.question: How often should I update the dataset?
faq.answer: Japan Post updates the data monthly. Refresh approximately monthly and report the dataset month when known.

faq.question: Does it print labels or verify complete street addresses?
faq.answer: No. It searches postal-code address records. Label printing, shipping, and complete residential address validation are outside its scope.
